scenes.title: Verify the session first
scenes.narration: In a new codebase, find the absolute repository root, read its agent instructions and .deslop.toml, and bind MCP's root to it. Run session once and verify its root field: a connection to another repository is not a useful empty result.
scenes.excerpt: "Run `session {}` once and verify its `root`; a connection to another repository is not a useful empty result."

scenes.title: Small summaries, all occurrences
scenes.narration: Request duplicates with detail summary and a small limit. Scope edits with path or path_contains, then use cluster-by-id and inspect every member, paging with offset, before editing. Keep overview pages small: full occurrences for one cluster, not hundreds of full clusters.
scenes.excerpt: "Keep overview pages small; request full occurrences for a selected cluster rather than hundreds of full clusters."

scenes.title: find-similar before writing
scenes.narration: Before adding a code unit, call find-similar with a snippet and its language. Inspect clusters and also existing occurrences outside any cluster. Empty clusters with non-empty existing means you are about to create a duplicate; no disk report answers this in-memory query.
scenes.excerpt: "An empty `clusters` with a non-empty `existing` means you are about to create a duplicate."

scenes.title: Tests, then requery
scenes.narration: After editing, run the project's tests and query the changed paths again. The live index refreshes automatically; use rescan only for suspected watcher lag. merge-plan is optional, and an ai_or_human verdict is not an executable merge.
scenes.excerpt: "Run the project's tests after editing and query the changed paths again. The live index refreshes automatically."
